'''Wytho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He fought as one of the commanders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces during the [[Korriban Incursion]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Imperial forces during their reclamation of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Korriban" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wytho appears as one of the four Jedi Masters that must be killed in the Sith Academy during the Imperial version of the "Korriban Incursion" Flashpoint, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7.<ref name="Korriban" />
